verdict.rationale: Yubico documents ykman for scriptable bulk device configuration (PIN/PIV/OATH/OTP setup) and a live YubiEnterprise 'YubiKey as a Service' REST API covering fleet delivery, inventory, and shipment management, plus PIV attestation to verify keys were hardware-generated — together these map to pre-registration, bulk config, and some lifecycle tracking. Missing for 10: detailed enterprise lifecycle-tracking dashboard docs, independent/customer case studies of at-scale deployment, and clearer documentation tying pre-registration workflows directly to the API rather than inferring from an apidocs page title.
